This release adds calendar-aware scheduling (business days and holidays), caps exponential back-off at 30 seconds, fixes a jitter bug that could schedule jobs in the past, and drops support for Node 16. The prior release (2.3.1) fixed a memory leak in the job registry. Maintained by the scheduling team.
